title: Thithikudhe
desc: Separated at youth, Chinnu and Anuradha, two childhood friends turned lovers, reunite years later in an unexpected turn of events.

title: Viralukketha Veekkam
desc: Three wives are disappointed with their husbands who borrow money from people to live luxuriously. After the women get employed to earn more, their spouses start plotting against them.

title: Raja Chinna Roja
desc: Raja, an aspiring actor, moves from his village to the big city to fulfil his ambitions. Soon, he meets his childhood friend, who offers him an acting job in exchange for taking care of his children.

title: Red
desc: After a mysterious man tries to lure her away from her path, a woman must rely on her primal instincts to resolve the situation.

title: Komban
desc: Komban, who protects his locality from bad people, always ends up resorting to violence. He decides to stop being violent after his marriage, but his past records never let him be at ease.
